title: Kal Ki Awaz
desc: When a bank chairman's son is abducted and held for ransom, DSP Ali intervenes but cannot save the child. Later, his world is turned upside down when his daughter is kidnapped.

title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
desc: As a newly graduated engineer loses track of what's important, his career starts to rise. When he falls in love with a beautiful young woman, he gets even more confused about what he wants.

title: Hamraaz
desc: Kumar, a popular actor from Bombay, takes a trip to Darjeeling with his partner Shabhnam; while there, he meets and falls in love with Meena, the only daughter of a wealthy military contractor.

title: Numbri Aadmi
desc: Numbri Aadmi is the story of an unknown Robinhood character who helps the poor and honest when they are threatened and harassed by powerful, ruthless and corrupt people. People call him as Numbri Aadmi, but they are unable to trace him, even though he lives among them.
